resources.string:
GymTracker writes your finished workouts to Health Connect so they appear alongside the rest of your health data.

It writes only: the start and end time of each workout, its name, and — when a workout was run on a watch with heart-rate permission — the heart-rate readings recorded during it.

It never reads anything from Health Connect, and nothing is shared with anyone else. You can turn this off at any time on the Account screen, and revoke the permission in Health Connect itself.
